title: Fixation demo (the alhazen new scaffold)
summary: The experiment `alhazen new fixation_demo` writes: one gaze-contingent fixation task. It documents the scaffold's own code and parameters; it reports no data.
references: alhazen-vision 2.13.0 or later, the toolkit this package is built on (https://github.com/sh4r11f/alhazen).

tasks.title: Fixation hold
tasks.summary: Look at the central point within a time limit, then keep looking at it for a fixed hold.

parameters.name: fix_size_dva
parameters.label: Fixation point size
parameters.meaning: Diameter of the fixation point, a filled white circle at the screen centre (drawn with radius fix_size_dva / 2).

parameters.name: fix_window_dva
parameters.label: Gaze window radius
parameters.meaning: Radius of the circular gaze window centred on the fixation point. Gaze must be inside it to acquire and to hold fixation; a lost sample (a blink, track loss) counts as outside.
parameters.interactions: The window is a gaze criterion only; it is never drawn on the screen.

parameters.name: acquire_timeout
parameters.label: Acquisition time limit

constraints.note: Give ms or frames; frames depend on the measured refresh rate.

parameters.meaning: How long the fixation point waits for gaze to enter the window. If gaze has not entered by then, the trial ends as NO_FIXATION. The time taken is recorded per trial as acquire_latency_s.

parameters.name: hold_duration
parameters.label: Hold duration
parameters.meaning: How long gaze must then stay inside the window. Any sample outside ends the trial as FIX_BREAK. Recorded per trial as hold_duration_s (the scaffold uses no jitter).

parameters.name: iti
parameters.label: Inter-trial interval
parameters.meaning: The interval the runner waits between trials. It is not part of a trial's own phases.

parameters.name: paradigm.kind
parameters.label: Scheduler

constraints.note: staircase and questplus need their own blocks in the params file.

parameters.meaning: How conditions are served. The scaffold has one condition, served n_per_condition times.

parameters.name: paradigm.n_per_condition
parameters.label: Trials per condition
parameters.meaning: Presentations of each condition in run mode. With the scaffold's single condition this is the planned number of completed trials.
parameters.interactions: Test and simulate turn trial counts down and print what they changed. A trial ending as FIX_BREAK is served again, so a session can take more attempts than this.

parameters.name: paradigm.shuffle
parameters.label: Shuffle trial order
parameters.meaning: Whether trials are served in random order. With one condition it changes nothing. Not set in configs/task.yaml; this is the params model's default.

outcomes.name: FIXATED
outcomes.meaning: Fixation was acquired and held for the whole hold.

outcomes.name: NO_FIXATION
outcomes.meaning: Gaze never entered the window before the acquisition limit. Counted as a trial without success.

outcomes.name: FIX_BREAK
outcomes.meaning: Gaze left the window (or was lost) during the hold. Not counted: the condition is served again.

events.name: FIX_ON
events.meaning: The fixation point's first frame, stamped with that flip's time.

events.name: FIX_ACQUIRED
events.meaning: Gaze first verified inside the window.

timeline.caption: One trial of the fixation hold. Acquisition waits on the subject, so its length is not drawn to scale; the hold is drawn at its default length.

branches.when: a gaze sample is outside the window or lost
a device fails or the experimenter skips the trial

diagram.caption: The centre of the display at the default parameters, to scale in degrees of visual angle. Mid-grey background and white point as the scaffold draws them; the dashed gaze window is a criterion and is not shown to the subject.
